text:
If you're still out chasing the last of the daylight, tonight's the easy part: partly cloudy skies, a light southeast breeze, and a low settling near 62. Lake's sitting calm too, water at 73 with waves just a foot or two, so an evening paddle or a walk along the waterfront is a fine call before things turn.

Sunday's the flip side. Showers move in before 2pm and look likely to stick around into the afternoon and evening, with thunder mixed in and highs only near 79, maybe cooler yet if the Euro's read verifies (it's notably wetter than the American model, with a stronger signal for rain). There's a low-end chance of an isolated strong storm, mainly south of us, but nothing widespread expected here. If you've got outdoor plans, mornings are your best window before the wet weather builds. Keep the rain jacket handy through the day, and don't count on the lake staying calm past midday.

Mostly sunny and warm through the day, high near 83, with evening thunderstorm chances building after dark.
Showers and thunderstorms likely again, high near 82, trending toward a soggier end to the week.
